parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal MDF shelf panel used inside the cabinet to support stored items.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a flat surface for placing objects and divides the cabinet into sections.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, not designed to move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle MDF shelf panel forming part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: Supports stored items and maintains cabinet organization.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, not designed to move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper MDF shelf panel providing additional storage space.
parts.Functional_description: Holds items and separates storage compartments.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, not designed to move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A lower MDF shelf panel forming part of the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: Supports stored items and provides structural stability.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, not designed to move.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A hinged MDF door attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Allows access to the cabinet’s interior and conceals stored items.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A sliding MDF drawer located in the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Provides enclosed storage space for smaller items.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main MDF structural frame of the cabinet enclosing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural integrity and supports shelves, door, and drawer.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; serves as the fixed body of the cabinet.
